content.value_statement: MDX chapters can become inconsistent when authors miss frontmatter, headings, or teaching elements. This skill reviews Docusaurus chapter content against clear structure, learning-flow, and component guidelines.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether a chapter uses the expected Docusaurus MDX location and file format.
Reviews YAML frontmatter for the required chapter fields.
Checks heading guidance, including an H2 body start and no body H1 heading.
Reviews the chapter flow for introductions, objectives, core content, interaction, and summaries.
Identifies expected Quiz, Simulation, Tabs, and TabItem component usage.
Checks tone guidance for accessible and encouraging instructional writing.
limitations: It provides guidance from the listed rules and does not run a Docusaurus build.
It does not verify whether MDX components are installed or render correctly.
It cannot measure learning outcomes or replace editorial review by a subject expert.
It only covers the chapter conventions described in the skill.

use_cases.title: Prepare a new lesson
use_cases.description: Review a draft MDX lesson before adding it to a Docusaurus textbook.

use_cases.title: Standardize course chapters
use_cases.description: Compare several chapters against the same frontmatter, heading, and teaching-flow rules.

use_cases.title: Check interactive learning content
use_cases.description: Confirm that major sections include appropriate Quiz or Simulation opportunities.

prompt_templates.title: Check one chapter
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Docusaurus MDX chapter with the Chapter Analyzer rules. List missing frontmatter fields, heading issues, and teaching-flow gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Improve chapter structure
prompt_templates.scenario: Revise a draft that has structural problems.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this chapter and propose a concise revision plan. Prioritize YAML frontmatter, heading hierarchy, introduction, objectives, interactive elements, and summary.

prompt_templates.title: Review component usage
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this MDX chapter for Quiz, Simulation, Tabs, and TabItem usage. Identify where an interactive element would improve a major section.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a chapter set
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced consistency review across multiple files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these Docusaurus MDX chapters against the Chapter Analyzer rules. Create a per-chapter checklist, rank the most important fixes, and identify conventions that differ across chapters.

output_examples.input: A chapter starts with an H1 heading and has no learning objectives.
output: Finding: The chapter body should start with H2 because the Docusaurus title serves as H1.
Finding: Add a short learning-objectives section after the introduction.
Next step: Add an interactive knowledge check to a major section.

output_examples.input: A draft has title and description frontmatter but no id or sidebar label.
output: Structure: Frontmatter should include the required chapter fields.
Tone: Use clear explanations for terms that may be unfamiliar to readers.

output_examples.input: A technical chapter has long prose sections without interaction.
output: Teaching-flow gap: Add a Quiz after a major concept to check understanding.
Component option: Use Tabs and TabItem for equivalent Python and C++ examples.
Completeness: End with a summary that recaps the key points.

best_practices: Provide the full chapter content, including frontmatter, for the most accurate review.
Apply structural fixes before refining wording and instructional tone.
Use the review as an editorial checklist before building or publishing the documentation.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the review as proof that the MDX file builds successfully.
Do not add interactive components without confirming that the site supports them.
Do not use the skill as the only review for technical accuracy or accessibility.

faq.question: What files does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews Docusaurus chapter files written in MDX or Markdown.

faq.question: Does it modify my chapter?
faq.answer: It analyzes the content and can suggest changes when requested. It does not guarantee automatic edits.

faq.question: Does it validate YAML syntax?
faq.answer: It checks the expected frontmatter fields, but it does not run a full YAML or site build validation.

faq.question: Can it check several chapters?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the chapters and ask for a consistency review across them.

faq.question: Does it verify Quiz and Simulation components?
faq.answer: It reviews their documented use in the chapter. It does not verify component installation or rendering.

faq.question: Can it replace an editor or subject expert?
faq.answer: No. Use it as a structured review aid alongside technical, editorial, and accessibility review.
